{{Quote|Zaloriis formally declares its independence!|Minister Transe Decar|audio=ZaloriisIndependence-SWGB.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The '''Askarian sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Hasaq system/Legends|Hasaq]] and [[Zaloriis system/Legends|Zaloriis systems]], which lay on the [[Nanth'ri Trade Route/Legends|Nanth'ri Trade Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], and also held the [[Askaria system/Legends|Askaria]], [[Knooda system/Legends|Knooda]], and [[Xandonia system/Legends|Xandonia systems]]. Parts of the Askarian sector, including the Hasaq [[Star system/Legends|system]], were held by [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between [[3959 BBY]] and [[3956 BBY]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Zalorian/Legends|Zalorian]] inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaloriis/Legends|Zaloriis]] rebelled against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] but were defeated by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

==Description==
The Askarian sector was a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. The northern reaches of the sector shared a four-way border with the [[Harron Marches/Legends|Harron Marches]], [[Serathrace sector/Legends|Serathrace]], and [[Hangshan sector/Legends|Hangshan sectors]]. Its eastern reaches intersected at another four-way border with the [[Hocatar sector/Legends|Hocatar]], [[Authala sector/Legends|Authala]], and [[Nuon e Safyd sector/Legends|Nuon e Safyd sectors]], the latter of which bordered all of the Askarian sector's southern border. The sector was also bordered by the [[Circarpous sector/Legends|Circarpous]] and [[Harron sector/Legends|Harron sectors]] on its eastern reaches, which also intersected at the border with the Harron Marches.<ref name="Region" /> The [[Nanth'ri Trade Route/Legends|Nanth'ri Trade Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]<ref name="TEA" /> passed through the Askarian sector through its border with the Circarpous sector,<ref name="Region" /> linking Askarian's [[Hasaq system/Legends|Hasaq]]<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Zaloriis system/Legends|Zaloriis systems]] with the [[Circarpous system/Legends|Circarpous system]] in its eponymous sector and with the [[Attahox system/Legends|Attahox system]] in the Hocatar sector.<ref name="Region" /> In addtion to the Hasaq and Zaloriis [[Star system/Legends|system]], the Askarian sector contained within it the [[Askaria system/Legends|Askaria]], [[Knooda system/Legends|Knooda]], and [[Xandonia system/Legends|Xandonia systems]].<ref name="EAOC" /> 

==Locations==
{{Quote|Zaloriis proved to be less than equal to the task of resisting Vader's will.|[[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]|audio=ZaloriisWeak.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Executor_on_Zaloriis.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Imperial ships approach Zaloriis.]]
The Hasaq system<ref name="EAOC" /> contained an [[Color/Legends|orange-colored]] [[Hasaq's sun|sun]].<ref name="KOTOR II">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> Between [[3959 BBY]] and [[3956 BBY]], during the [[Jedi Civil War]], territory within the Askarian sector, including the Hasaq sysem, was held by [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]].<ref name="TEA" /> 

The Zaloriis system contained the desolate [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaloriis/Legends|Zaloriis]], which, during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], served as the secret development site of the Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport (AT-AT)]], overseen by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="GB" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Zalorian Separatists]], led by [[Zalor Minister]] [[Transe Decar]], joined forces with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to defect from the Empire. Decar avoided paying Zaloriis's [[Standard month/Legends|monthly]] tribute to the Empire, which attracted the attention of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. He travelled to the Zaloriis system and, after overcoming a trap set by Decar, [[Zaloriis campaign/Legends|destroyed]] the rebels. Vader and Veers then departed the system to continue searching for the [[Echo Base/Legends|rebel base]].<ref name="GB" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|I have to tell you, of all the assassins they've sent after me, and there've been quite a few&mdash;flesh-eating nano-bots, brain-snipers from Latza VII, a Xandonian night terror&mdash;you two are the ''worst''.|The pirate [[Attuma Duum]], to cult leader [[Shon-Ju]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]|<ref name="Shon-Ju">''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''</ref>}}
A type of [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] called a [[Xandonian night terror]]<ref name="Shon-Ju" /> originated in the Xandonia system.<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Xandonian night terror]]s|system=Xandonia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> The Zaloriis system was inhabited by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Zalorian]]s.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Askarian sector was first mentioned in a map illustrated by [[Modi]] in the Expansion Region edition of [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]], published on [[October 26]], [[2012]]. The map placed the sector in grid squares O-11, O-12, P-11 & P-12,<ref name="EAOC" /> and included the Zaloriis system within the sector. Zaloriis was first visually depicted in [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]], published on [[November 7]], [[2001]],<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> before making a narrative appearance in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' on [[November 11]], 2001,<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> retroactively establishing these sources as the first depictions of the Askarian sector.<ref name="GB" />
